free_tier.stated: Free plan at USD 0 a month: a single user, up to 2 active devices, 30 minutes refilled monthly, and a 3-minute session limit; usage is throttled capacity.
free_tier.notes: Streaming time runs from the start of a stream until the user leaves the page or the session times out. The Starter plan is USD 59 a month billed annually (USD 89 monthly) with 500 minutes included then USD 0.06 a minute.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is streaming minutes, not an object

retention.stated: Sessions run in isolated environments and clear when they end; no separate retention period is stated on the pricing or homepage.

egress.terms: not published as a streaming allowance: the pricing page bills streaming minutes rather than traffic and states no egress price or per-session byte cap

interface_detail: An Appetize CLI and REST API at api.appetize.io/v1 with X-API-KEY authentication, plus a JavaScript SDK and embeddable browser streaming links.
tooling: Appetize CLI, the v1 REST API with an organization API token, the JavaScript SDK, and Playwright-based automation (AppRecorder) against streamed devices.
chaining: A user uploads an APK or build and streams an iOS simulator or Android emulator in the browser, or drives it from a coding agent through the CLI or REST API; the paid continuation is USD 0.06 a minute after 500 included minutes on Starter.

limits.value: 30 streaming minutes a month on Free; 500 minutes then USD 0.06 a minute on Starter
2 active devices at once on Free; 3 on Starter and 16 on Premium
3-minute session limit on Free, unlimited on paid plans, and throttled capacity on Free

limits_note: API Access is listed only on the paid plans in the comparison table; the Free column leaves that feature unchecked. Payment methods accepted are Visa, Mastercard and American Express through Stripe.
binding_note: The 3-minute session limit and throttled capacity cut a Free session short before the 30 monthly minutes are used, and the comparison table leaves API access off the Free plan.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page shows an email input and offers Sign Up with Google and Sign Up with GitHub. The login page offers email and password, Google and GitHub. No card is asked on the sign-up page; the free plan needs no payment method, while paid plans take Visa, Mastercard or American Express through Stripe.

reliability_note: Free sessions are capped at 3 minutes and run at throttled capacity; sessions clear when they end. The pricing page states a 99.9% uptime SLA, which is an enterprise-level commitment rather than a Free-plan guarantee.
confidence_note: Prices, limits, sign-up fields and API terms are quoted from first-party Appetize pages read on 2026-11-25.
